title: OAS distribution package manifest (oas-package.json)
description: Manifest at a distribution-package root. A package is the source, acquisition, dependency, update, integrity, and review unit; it explicitly enumerates the capabilities and config profiles it ships. Install never ambiently loads undeclared files. Every declared path is package-relative and must remain inside the locked package after symlink resolution.

package.description: Package identity. Namespaced separately from capability IDs; unique at one config scope.

oas.description: OAS kernel compatibility floor. Accepted grammar exactly: >=x.y.z, ^x.y.z, or exact x.y.z.

capabilities.description: Package-relative directories each containing one capability oas.json. Paths must not escape the package root after symlink resolution.

configs.description: Named config profiles: complete reference oas-config.yaml files that an adopter may snapshot with `oas init --package`. Profiles are config source material, never live policy.

path.description: Package-relative path to the profile's oas-config.yaml.

default.description: At most one profile may be marked default; it removes the need for --config at adoption.

dependencies.description: Package source specifications (NOT capability IDs): official catalog selectors (e.g. "oas.okf@v1.4.0"), git:host/org/repo@ref, raw HTTPS/SSH git URLs with @ref, or local paths. No general semver ranges; the resolved closure is exact-locked.
